text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: quantile score of a stage (a score of the whole forecast range, in points of capacity; smaller is better). Thick line: 95% interval of the step from the stage above, drawn from that stage's dot, not the uncertainty of the dot's own position. Dotted line joins the two dots. Thin grey line: the first rung's own interval. The order of the ideas shapes each step's size. Ideas tested and not adopted: Zero start (experiment 80) (tested and not adopted: no gain); Switching masks (experiment 75) (tested and not adopted: no gain over a random mask).'
text.tspan: Dot: quantile score of a stage (a score of the whole forecast range, in points of capacity; smaller is
better). Thick line: 95% interval of the step from the stage above, drawn from that stage's dot, not the
uncertainty of the dot's own position. Dotted line joins the two dots. Thin grey line: the first rung's own
interval. The order of the ideas shapes each step's size. Ideas tested and not adopted: Zero start
(experiment 80) (tested and not adopted: no gain); Switching masks (experiment 75) (tested and not adopted:
no gain over a random mask).
